observations.code_quote: `Read the report first and find its open, approved pull request with the inbox MCP tools. Work only on that pull request, on its own branch. Do not open a second PR. Fix failing CI checks with the smallest change that keeps what the reviewer approved. If the branch conflicts with its base, update it from the base branch and resolve each conflict so that both sides keep their intent: keep the base branch's changes and reapply this PR's change on top of them, then run the affected tests. Then merge it with the repository's own merge process: read its contribution guide and agent instructions first, and use its merge queue when it has one. This request approves the merge of this pull request only. Stop and ask the person before you continue when the work needs a decision they did not make: a fix that changes what the PR does, a new review that requests changes, a failure that this PR did not cause, or a merge rule that needs a person. Do not change the report state: the merge resolves the report.`,
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the instructions provided to an AI agent regarding how to handle a merged PR, including conflict resolution and repository-specific merge processes.
